name: I R Technology Services Pvt Ltd
capabilities: X Ray diffraction and Fluorescence analysers
india_angle: IR Technology Services Pvt Ltd has been introducing advanced instrumentation technology in India since 1961.
summary: IR Technology Services Pvt Ltd markets sophisticated analytical instruments, including X Ray diffraction and fluorescence analysers, industrial microscopes, and handheld XRF analyzers. These instruments support research and development in various industries, including semiconductors, by providing critical test and measurement capabilities.
